title: Civic Notice: The Curfew
description: A flat automated Snazzie FM Civic Notification System bulletin reminding listeners of a curfew that was never announced, already in effect, enforced by the fog after dark.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: This is a test of the Snazzie FM Civic Notification System. <p:0.5> The curfew is in effect. It has always been in effect.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: At nightfall, return to the address on file. <p:0.5> If you do not have an address on file, the fog will assign you one.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: If a neighbor knocks after curfew, do not answer. <p:0.3> There are no neighbors after curfew.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-deep
lines.text: The curfew began three years ago. <p:0.5> Thank you for your continued compliance. <p:0.5> Everyone heard the announcement. Everyone is, after all, still inside.
